claim: If you use root, IAM users, or federation with IAM for AWS account access, AWS recommends short-term credentials obtained by logging in to the CLI with your console credentials; IAM Identity Center workforce users also use short-term credentials, and security best practice is AWS Organizations with IAM Identity Center.

values.display: Use short-term credentials by logging into the AWS CLI with your console credentials
values.spoken: log in to the CLI with your console credentials to get short-term credentials

values.display: Security best practice is to use AWS Organizations with IAM Identity Center

qualifiers.condition: the console-credentials recommendation applies if you use root, IAM users, or federation with IAM for AWS account access
